name: receiver-filter
description: Step 3b of the receiver-motion study: the receiver's position and velocity estimated by a Kalman filter from simulated GNSS position fixes (true trajectory + the step 3a error model), for every step 1 motion case. No radar: the filter is checked against the true trajectory. Variants: kf (state [x, v, nu] per axis, nu the GNSS error's Gauss-Markov part), white (same filter treating all GNSS error as white), raw (latest fix, velocity by differencing).
